notes.title: Shadowgate 2 available to download today!
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2749220/ss_eaa8adaa072ad92e8387f6235f104e0f0b8c88d4.1920x1080.jpg?t=1738740902[/img]

Zojoi has licensed the Shadowgate property to Forever Entertainment and they have created a super cool sequel to Shadowgate 2014! Here's the details!

Enjoy a 10% Release Discount on the game for two weeks, starting from launch day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2749220/Shadowgate_2/

[b]About Shadowgate 2:[/b]

Magic is fading from the land of Kal Torlin, and a sinister darkness creeps once more across the realm.You take on the role of Raven, the great-great-granddaughter of Lakmir the Timeless, as she embarks on a perilous journey to restore the ancient magic to its rightful place. With nothing but Lakmir’s Chrono-Orb and the company of her ever-sarcastic companion, Yorick, Raven must brave the twisted halls of Castle Shadowgate, where devious monsters and cunning puzzles await. 
To succeed, Raven must unravel the secrets hidden within her storybook, mastering six powerful schools of magic. Deciphering its ancient clues will mean the difference between victory… or an untimely demise. The Shadowgate castle awaits you, the fate of Kal Torlin rests upon your shoulders!

[b]Game Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3D rendered environments allow you to experience the magical keep like never before.
[*] Six unique levels, replete with devious puzzles that will test even the most seasoned adventurer
[*] A new turned-based combat system that requires deciphering Storybook clues and exploiting your opponent’s weaknesses with powerful spells.
[*] Move seamlessly through the Castle’s past and present with a powerful Chrono-Orb.
[*] Call upon Yorick’s hints in your quest to find and use objects of interest that’ll prove most useful in unlocking new locations and progressing through the castle.
[*] Dive into Shadowgate’s unique ambiance through Rich Douglas’ signature soundtrack and sound design.
[*] Enjoy engaging storytelling written by the original creators.
[*] Four characters fully-dubbed in English with localized text for Polish, French, German, Spanish.
[/list]

notes.title: Shadowgate VR Is Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6024452/d3747a0b2f97d6c54bbae8b2d6bf3fb634b420a7.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
A new game in the long running adventure game series Shadowgate, created and developed by Zojoi, finally comes to both VR and Steam. Chosen by the legendary druid Lakmir the Timeless in his quest to stop the dark machinations of the Warlock Lord, you must first confront that which lies waiting deep within the Mines of Mythrok.

Immerse yourself in the award-winning fantasy adventure like never before! Apply your cunning wit and magical prowess in equal measure to conquer challenging puzzles, triumph over powerful opponents and survive minecart thrills as your journey progresses through dark dungeons and mystical caverns. You won’t be alone on your adventure! Odin the raven, once Lakmir’s familiar, is now at your beckon call, providing mystical insights and timely hints as you uncover the secrets buried within the legendary Dwarven mines.

[u][h2][b]Shadowgate VR will soon be available on Steam![/b][/h2][/u]
[h3]Wishlist the game now to be one of the first to know when it launches![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822970/Shadowgate_VR_The_Mines_of_Mythrok/

You can also join the developers and community of Shadowgate over on [url=https://discord.gg/NVCX8hk8XW]Discord![/url]

Join here: https://discord.gg/NVCX8hk8XW

[b]We hope to see you within the mines soon, Sorcerer![/b]

notes.title: SHADOWGATE GETS WICKED WITH PACKED HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.content:
Available in this weekend’s Halloween sale, the new Shadowgate update showcases a litany of new features and improvements that will help adventurers navigate the treacherous dangers of the living castle Shadowgate. Included in this update is a limited time haunting side-quest entitled the ‘Dread Pumpkin Quest’, an alternate command system, new Casual and Ironman game modes, a retro graphics add-on, additional achievements and much more!

Key updates include:
[olist]
[*][b]Alternate Command System[/b]: In addition to the Classic/Retro command system, we now offer an additional way to interact with the game world: a modern icon-based system. Immersive (Hide UI) mode, keybinds and locking are still available in this mode.
[*][b]Casual Game Mode[/b]: Perfect for those unfamiliar with the Shadowgate universe. The game is very forgiving, offers unlimited torch life and generally keeps the Grim Reaper at bay.
[*][b]Ironman Mode[/b]: Perfect for advanced players. In this mode, saved games are disabled, requiring you to complete your grand adventure in one sitting.
[*][b]Brand New Halloween Themed Side-Quest[/b]: The ‘Dread Pumpkin Quest’ sends you on a mysterious and festive quest to find and release a terrifying spirit.
[*][b]Show All Objects[/b]: For those that want a bit of help, this key bind highlights all objects in a room.
[*][b]Quick Load Option[/b]: This additional key bind is for quick loading a saved game.
[*][b]Tutorials and Hints Changes[/b]: The tutorials and hint text have been overhauled to be even more helpful.
[*][b]UI Elements[/b]: The UI elements are adjusted in size to offer more visibility of each scenes. Also, the Load/Save dialogues have been relocated for ease of use.
[*][b]Additional Achievements[/b]: Gotta catch them all, Ironman, Seven Angry Dwarven Miners, Signal the Castle, Book Collector, Pyromaniac and Pumpkin Hunter.
[*][b]Adjustments to “USE” command[/b]: The USE command now requires only one click to work on stationary objects like levers and such. 
[*][b]Retro Graphics Option[/b]: A pixelated filter has been added for those who wish to play the game in retro graphics mode. This fun extra is easily turned on and off in the settings or via a keybind.
[*][b]Destroyable Objects[/b]: Key objects cannot be destroyed in easier difficulty settings.
[*][b]Settings screens[/b]: Added a third volume slider for cut scenes, revamped the options screen and added additional keybinds.
[*][b]Adjustments To Enemy-based Puzzles[/b]: Some examples include the shadow wraith which will no longer return and the goblins archers which have a lower firing percentage.
[*][b]Lots of tweaks to graphics and text.[/b]
[*][b]And much more![/b]
[/olist]

notes.title: SHADOWGATE GETS WICKED WITH PACKED HALLOWEEN UPDATE!
notes.content:
Available in late October, a new Shadowgate update showcases a haunting Halloween-themed addition entitled the ‘Dread Pumpkin Quest’ that will have players as well as a litany of improvements ranging from an alternate command system, additional achievements, overhauls to the tutorial system, and new Casual and Ironman game modes.

Also with this new Shadowgate update, players will enjoy improved save and load features, object visibility options, a retro graphics add-on, destroyable objects, and much more that will help adventurers navigate the treacherous dangers of the living fortress Shadowgate.

The full list of upcoming updates for Shadowgate includes:

•	Alternate Command System: We will offer players two command systems and turn current system into the Retro system. The new system will be a wheel system where (on easier modes) only commands that can be used will be available (highlighted). Other modes would have all commands on the wheel. Several verbs will be combined together as well. All keybinds and locking will still work in this mode.
•	Brand New Halloween Themed Quest: The ‘Dread Pumpkin Quest’ sends players on a mysterious and festive quest to find and free a great spirit. Special items include an ancient mask, carving knives, candles, wizard hat, cloak, and lots of new rooms and puzzles.
•	Tutorials Overhaul:  With the inclusion of the command wheel, there need two tutorials. Various things are being added to tutorials that we have seen players struggle with.
•	Adjust size of UI Elements: The UI elements could be reduced to offer more visability of the scene. On top of that, we will move the load/save to the options gear.
•	Additional Achievements: Gotta catch them all! (Catching all the elementals), Seven Angry Dwarven Miner (Mining all the gems in the catacombs), Signal the Castle (Lighting the fire pyre and examining it in Room22), Book Collector (Reading all the books in the game), Pyromaniac! (burning all things that disappear in the game).
•	Casual Game Mode: The casual mode is just that - for casual players. The game is very forgiving and there are very few objects in the game that aren't required for puzzles. It is also much more difficult for players to die or lose the game.
•	Ironman Mode: Each mode will have an checkbox available for Ironman mode. In this mode, players will not be able to save the game and must play in one sitting.
•	Mouse Click Adjustments: Makes the mouse more sensitive to clicking on objects.
•	Changes to Useable Object View: Adding a key bind that will glow all objects in the room.
•	Quick Load Option: Added a key bind for quick loading a game.
•	Changes to Save/Load: Add Save and Load separately to the options gear on right. This keeps players from accidentally saving over a load, etc.
•	Adjustments to “USE” command: The USE command will work better on things like levers and such if you simply hit USE and then the object.
•	Destroyable Objects: Key objects will not be destroyed in easier difficulty settings.
•	Changes To Room Names: Room names being altered to make them more consistent and less ambiguous.
•	Hints Being Tweaked: Hints are being tweaked on all levels to be even more helpful.
•	Polish Of All Difficulty Levels: Add polish and more interactions to actions to reduce generic comments.
•	Revising Keybind Location: With the inclusion of new settings features, the keybinds get their own screen.
•	Retro Graphics Option: Retro graphics will be put into the game as a pixelated filter. This will be more of a fun lark that is easily turned on and off in the settings or via a keybind.
•	Adjustments To Enemy-based Puzzles: Some examples include the Wraith will no longer return and goblins will have a lower firing percentage.
•	New Difficulty Descriptions: Need to add a difficulty dialogue update for the new modes.
•	Fixes To Window Text: Go thru the text and fix as many widows as possible.
•	Easy Mode: Make it less deadly- similar to Casual
•	Revision to Curse: There will be additional graphic/text info when the curse is affecting you so players know what is going on.
•	Third Slider for Cutscenes: Add a third slider for handling audio in cut scenes.
